cases.title: Scenario-matrix row for QR token behavior rejects expired token
preconditions: Testing-plan §3 QR token behavior block applies (FR-11, FR-12, BR-03, BR-04, AC-02, AC-03, AC-04).
Student account is authenticated and enrolled in class section
Class session is Open and has rotating QR token with 30-second TTL
steps: Generate a valid token for the open session and advance test clock beyond token expiresAt
Submit POST /v1/check-ins with expired qrToken and idempotency key
Read persisted CheckInAttempt for the request correlation id
cases.expected: Attempt is rejected and persisted with structured outcome code ExpiredQr under AC-04 coverage row; no successful AttendanceRecord is created.

cases.title: Check-in transaction writes failed attempt for expired or wrong-session token
preconditions: Database has one Open session A and one Open session B with distinct token bindings
Student is enrolled only in session A section
Request correlation and idempotency metadata are enabled
steps: Submit check-in with token bound to session B while student targets session A flow
Submit check-in with an expired token bound to session A
Query CheckInAttempt table and AttendanceRecord table in the same transaction boundary
cases.expected: Each invalid request creates one failed CheckInAttempt with reason code (ExpiredQr at 422 or invalid-session equivalent such as MalformedQrToken at 400 per BR-04) and creates no successful AttendanceRecord.

cases.title: Lecturer open-close lifecycle gates token validity window
preconditions: Lecturer is assigned to the class section
Session starts in Scheduled state
steps: Call POST /v1/class-sessions/{sessionId}/open as Lecturer and capture issued token metadata
Call POST /v1/class-sessions/{sessionId}/close as Lecturer
Attempt POST /v1/check-ins using the previously issued token after close
cases.expected: Session transitions Scheduled->Open->Closed are accepted, and post-close check-in using stale token is rejected with structured failure (SessionClosed or invalidated token per BR-02) without new success record; failed attempt is logged.

cases.title: Parallel duplicate submissions preserve single success invariant
preconditions: Student has one valid token for an Open session
No existing successful attendance record exists for this student-session pair
steps: Send two concurrent POST /v1/check-ins requests for same student and same token with different idempotency keys
Collect both API outcomes and inspect persisted attendance records
cases.expected: At most one request succeeds and any duplicate path returns DuplicateCheckIn conflict (409), preserving one success per student-session.

cases.title: POST /v1/check-ins returns 422 envelope with ExpiredQr for expired token
preconditions: Student is authenticated and enrolled
Open session exists with token that can be expired deterministically
steps: Let issued QR token exceed 30-second TTL
Call POST /v1/check-ins with expired qrToken and required headers
Validate HTTP status, envelope shape (data/meta/error), and error.code
Verify failed CheckInAttempt is persisted for the request
cases.expected: API returns 422 with error.code ExpiredQr, stable envelope schema (data/meta/error), no restricted or inconsistent payload leakage, and a failed attempt row is written per AC-18.

cases.title: Wrong-session or malformed token is rejected with documented error code
preconditions: Two active sessions exist in different sections with distinct QR tokens
Student is authenticated in a check-in flow for session A
steps: Submit POST /v1/check-ins using session B token while attempting session A attendance
Record HTTP status and error.code from response envelope
Read check-in attempt record from audit trail
cases.expected: Request is rejected with structured invalid-session reason (MalformedQrToken at 400 or documented equivalent per API §2.4 and BR-04), logged as failed CheckInAttempt, and no successful attendance mutation is created.

cases.title: Out-of-scope roles are denied report and export APIs without data leakage
preconditions: Student account and out-of-scope Lecturer account exist without cross-section grants
ITAdmin identity is available without explicit academic export grant
Attendance data exists in multiple sections
steps: Call GET /v1/reports/attendance as Student and as out-of-scope Lecturer
Call POST /v1/exports/attendance with filters outside actor scope for Student, out-of-scope Lecturer, and ITAdmin
Verify status and body contain denial code (403 Forbidden/OutOfScope) and no partial restricted data
cases.expected: Unauthorized role/scope calls are denied with authorization errors and return no cross-scope report rows, pagination counts, or export artifacts.

cases.title: Student browser flow shows expired-token error and allows retry path
preconditions: Student is logged in on mobile-web browser
Lecturer opened session and QR is displayed with rotating TTL
steps: Student scans token after TTL expiry and submits check-in on PG-02 (/check-in?token=...)
Observe inline error reason displayed for expired token on CheckInResultScreen
Student rescans fresh QR token and re-submits
cases.expected: UI surfaces structured expired-token failure feedback for first attempt and permits retry with fresh token without breaking session flow (testing-plan E2E-04).

cases.title: Check-in result screen maps ExpiredQr and MalformedQrToken errors per FRM-11
preconditions: Student is authenticated on mobile-web check-in route (PG-02 /check-in?token=...)
Open session exists with rotating QR; harness can deterministically expire token or substitute wrong-session token
steps: Submit check-in after QR token TTL expiry and observe CheckInResultScreen (FRM-11)
Confirm result displays ExpiredQr copy intent "Mã QR đã hết hạn. Vui lòng quét mã mới." with visible rescan next-action
Repeat with a token bound to a different session and confirm MalformedQrToken copy intent "Mã QR không hợp lệ. Vui lòng quét lại." with rescan guidance per forms-validation §5
Verify failure is announced via aria-live and uses icon plus text, not color alone
cases.expected: Per FRM-11 and error-code UX mapping §5, expired (422 ExpiredQr) and wrong-session/malformed (400 MalformedQrToken) rejections render on CheckInResultScreen with correct localized reason, actionable retry guidance, and accessible failure feedback without exposing restricted session data.
